units.translation: 106-108 : In the Apsavya cycle, Mandooka type of movements will set in trouble to wife, children etc., possibility of fever and fall in status. Dasas of the signs in Markati motion produces; fear from water, loss of position, death of father, punishment from the authorities (Govt. etc.) and wandering in the forest be expected. In sign-Dasas with Simhavlokana motion in Apsavya cycle, service-loss or reduction in rank, death of father or near relation be considered.
units.commentary:
Notes: In the publication of Chaukhambha, the results of the Mandooka movements in the sign-Dasa are, fear from the species of lion, futile efforts etc. In all the three types of movements, loss of status, position etc. is indicated but the reasons for such loss in all these cases are experienced quite differently. These are as follows :
i) In Mandooka, the native will not be guilty. He does not do any irregular thing intentionally which could cause fall in the status. Generally, the rules and regulations bring about his fall.
ii) In case of Markati-type of sign Dasas, some kind of irregularity or mistakes on the part of the native become the cause of his down fall. It is normally seen that during the distressed time, one does not get any support from the influential people and the native has to perforce face the consequences as laid down in the Shlokas.
iii) However, in the Simhavlokana kind of sign-Dasa, the native miserably suffers due to his negligence and he is made responsible for his acts.

units.verse_devanagari:
ज्ञेयं सग्रहभावस्य ग्रहयोगसमं फलं ।
अग्रहस्य तु भावस्य ग्रहदृष्टिसमं फलम् ।। ११ ।।
शुभैरेव शुभं, पापैरशुभं, मिश्रखेचरैः ।
शुभाधिके शुभं ज्ञेयमशुभं त्वशुभाधिके ।। १२ ।।
एवं भावेषु खेटानां योगं दृष्टिं विलोक्य च ।
तारतम्येन वाच्यानि फलानि द्विजसत्तम ! ।। १३ ।।
units.translation: 11-13 : The results of the combined houses, be considered on the basis of the presence of the planets over there. If a house is devoid of planet but receives the aspect, the results be stated accordingly. The house having the benefic planets will be auspicious and the house occupied by the malefics, will deliver inauspicious results. If a house holds mixed planets (both the benefic and malefic), the results will be auspicious, if the number of the benefic planets is more and if the malefic planets are more in numbers, the malefic results will prevail. In this manner, the combinations and the aspects of the planets to a particular house (i.e. the benefic aspects to a houses will deliver auspicious and malefic aspects to a house will cause inauspicious results) be taken into account and the result be stated in accordance to the factors which are more pronoduced.
units.commentary:
Notes : The important principles propounded in the foregoing Shlokas are very useful from the point of view of predicting the results. They are summed up as follows : (i) The first and the formost principle is that the results of the house will depend upon the planets occupying the house.

(ii) In the absence of any planet, the results are delineated on the basis of the aspects received by a particular house.

(iii) The consideration of auspiciousness and inauspiciousness of the planets in a house is very important. If it is assessed that all the planets are benefic, the auspicious results will come in planty and easily. If malefic planets are influencing the house, such house will be deprived of the results connected with the Karatakwa of the house.

(iv) If a house is holding both benefic and malefic planets, the results will be influenced by the planets which are more in number.

(v) Suppose the number of both benefic and malefic are identical, in that case, the strength of the planets is to be ascertained. If the strength of the benefic planet is more, the results will be auspicious and in a reverse situation, the malefic planets will gain the strength. (vi) If a house is bereft of planets, the results will be on the basis of aspects. Benefic aspects will indicate auspicious and malefic inauspicious results. Should both types of aspects be in an equal proportion, the strength of the asspects will decide the result.

units.verse_devanagari:
कृत्तिकातः समारभ्य त्रिरावृत्य दशाधिपाः ।
आ-चं-कु-रा-गु-श-बु-के-शुपूर्वा विहगाः क्रमात् ।। १२ ।।
वह्निभाज्जन्मभं यावद् या संख्या नवतष्टिता ।
शेषाद्दशाधिपो ज्ञेयस्तमारभ्य दशां नयेत् ।। १३ ।।
विंशोत्तरशतं पूर्णमायुः पूर्वमुदाहृतम् ।
कलौ विंशोत्तरी तस्माद् दशा मुख्या द्विजोत्तम ! ।। १४ ।।
units.translation: 12-14 : Commencing from Kritika, the Dasa lords in succession would be Sun, Moon, Mars, Rahu, Jupiter, Saturn, Mercury, Ketu, Venus; in the three cycles of Nakshatras. The number of Nakshatras between Kritika and the birth Nakshatra be divided by 9. The remainder will indicate the Dasa lord if counted from the Sun. (Let us suppose the remainder being 5, then the Dasa lord will be Jupiter at the time of birth. The subsequent Dasas will be in the same order i.e. after Jupiter comes the Dasa of Saturn, Mercury, Ketu and so on). O Brahmin! The full span of life of man in ‘Kalayuga’ is said to be 120 years (Purna Ayu). Therefore, amongst the various Dasas, Vimshottari Dasa is the prime Dasa system.
units.commentary:
Notes : There are 27 Nakshatras. In order to find out the Dasa ruling at the time of birth, count the number of Nakshatras which have passed from Kritika to the birth Nakshatra and divide the number by 9 i.e. total number of planets including Rahu and Ketu and each Nakshatra has a planet assigned as its lord.
The remainder will indicate the Dasa lord counting it from the Sun. Suppose the birth was in Dhanista Nakshatra i.e. 23rd Nakshatra. From Kritika, its number comes to 21 (both inclusive) the remainder will be 3 if this figure is divided by 9. The third planet Dasa-lord is Mars from Sun. Hence, at the time of birth, Dasa of Mars will be in operation.

units.verse_devanagari:
शूरश्चौरश्च मेषांशे लक्ष्मीवांश्च वृषांशके ।
मिथुनांशे भवेज्ज्ञानी कर्कांशे नृपतिर्भवेत् ।।१२०।।
सिंहांशे राजमान्यश्च कन्यांशे पण्डितो भवेत् ।
तुलांशे राजमन्त्री स्याद् वृश्चिकांशे च निर्धनः ।।१२१।।
चापांशे ज्ञानसम्पन्नो मकरांशे च पापकृत् ।
कुम्भांशे च वणिक्कर्मा मीनांशे धनधान्यवान् ।।१२२।।
units.translation: 120-122: According to the Kalachakra Dasa system, if the birth is in the Navamsa of Aries, the native will be brave but a thief. If the birth be in the Taurus Navamsa, the native will be wealthy and the Gemini Navamsa makes the native learned. The Cancer Navamsa's birth, will get him kingship. The native will be honoured by the king (authorities) if birth is in Leo Navamsa. If the birth be in the Navamsa of Virgo, the native becomes scholar. The birth in Libra Navamsa gets him ministership (a very high Government position) while in Scorpio Navamsa makes him pauper. If birth is in Sagittarius Navamsa, the native will be highly educated but birth in the Navamsa of Capricorn makes him commit sins. The native becomes businessman if born in the Aquarius Navamsa and if the birth be in the Pisces Navamsa, he becomes wealth.
units.commentary: Notes: The Navamsa of the Ascendant (Lagna) is not to be confused with the Navamsa referred to in the Kalachakra Dasa system. In this scheme, the position of the Moon a quarter (Pada) of the Nakshatra belonging to either Savya or Apsavya group of Nakshatras decides the "Navamsa". The Kalachakra Dasa Navamsa for the position of the Moon, in a quarter of Savya Nakshatras is just like her position in the natal chart. For example: The four quarters (Padas) of the Aswini Nakshatras are represented by the Navamsas Aries, Taurus, Gemini and Cancer signs. Similarly the four quarters of Bharani Nakshatra are assigned to the Navamsas of Leo, Virgo, Libra and Scorpio. In the same manner, the Navamsas of Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius and Pisces are assigned to the four quarters (Padas) of kritika Nakshatras. The same pattern is followed in the allotment of sign-Navamsa to the different quarters (Padas) of the other Nakshatras of Savya group of total 15 Nakshatras. In Apsavya group of Nakshatras, the distribution of Navamsa- Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra 73 sign is altogether on a different footings. In this scheme, the natal Moon has no relevance. In Apsavya, the allotment cycle of the Navamsa-sign is in the reverse order commencing from Scorpio, Libra, Leo, Cancer, Gemini, Taurus, Aries etc. There are twelve Navamsa-signs (the 12 zodiacal signs). As per the explanations rendered in respect of Savya and Apsavya Nakshatras and the distributions of the Navams-sign to their respective quarters (Padas), two tables are drawn i.e. Table-21 and Table-22 which will make the concept amply clear. In Kalachakradasa system, the corresponding Navamsa-sign of the Mahadasa would discern the promise of the natal chart. With the change of the Dasa of the Navamsa-sign, the results will also get altered. For example: in the Mahadasa of Gemini, the Navamsa of Taurus which is akin to poisons, chemicals or death due to the reaction of medicine but these results will get changed the moment Gemini Navamsa Dasa becomes operative. The native in this period, will be blessed with happiness, festivities, comforts, alacrity, briskness, will get help in accomplishing his pursuits, gets facilities of physical and material comforts.

units.translation: 13-16: Now I explain the procedure for working out the Antardasas of Pinda etc., which are of three types (Pinda, Amsa, Naisargika). The lord of the operating Dasa will have full part (1) and planet in conjunction with it will have half part (½), the planet in Trines from it will have one-third part (1/3), the planet in 4th and 8th from it will have one fourth part (¼), the plant located at 7th house from it will have one seventh part (1/7) of the span of the Dasa span lord. In this manner, the eight planets, including the Ascendant, mutually located are the Antardasa lords (Pachaka - पाचक) of the Dasa. If there are more than one planets in these houses, the stronger amongst them will be the Antardasa lord (पाचक). The parts
units.commentary: (proportion) of all the Antardasas of the Dasa be coverted with a common denomination and by omitting this denominator, the numerators will indicate non-fractional digits of each planet. By multiplying the figure of a particular planet with the Dasa years and then dividing it by the sum total of the digits of all the planets, it will give the Antardasa of each planet. Like Antardasa, the Pratyantar Dasas be worked out. Notes: The full Dasa span of a planet (according to Chapter 45) in term of Ayuvarsha of the planet is equal to total longevity because the lord of the full Dasa span is the Dasalord and his part in the Dasa is full (1/1). A planet in conjunction, will have ½ part, and the planets in Trines, 4th, 8th and 7th will have respectively ¼, ¼, 1/7 parts. If more than one planets are in conjunction with the Dasalord, the strongest amongst them will only have the right of representing the Antardasa. In this context the sayings of Acharya Yamaha give an explicit indication.

units.translation: 155-156 : The method of calculating Chara Dasa : Now I explain the Chara Dasas from the Ascendant to the 12th house. In this Dasa system, the number of signs from the sign of the house upto the lord of the sign will denote the number of years of the Dasa of the said sign. Three signs put together in succession from Aries constitute one quarter (Pada). In order to ascertain the period (years) of Chara Dasa, the counting of the signs of odd quarters (1,3) be done in forward order, while for signs of even quarters (2, 4) it should be in the reverse order.
units.commentary: Notes : Chara Dasa relates to twelve houses and correspondingly , it pertains to the sign of the twelve houses. With a view to get acquainted to this kind of system, first of all one has to understand the divisions of the signs into four quarters. To start with, the twelve signs are to be distributed into even and odd quarters. In this connection, Maharishi Parasara has very aptly said that three signs starting from Aries would form one quarter and the remaining nine signs will create, in succession, the rest of the three quarters. The groupifications of the twelve signs into four quarters is accordingly, illustrated in the table appended below :- Maharishi Jaimini in Chapter 2, Part 3 and Shloka 29 of in his famous aphorism, has given his advise on the following lines. There will be forward counting for the signs of the odd quarters. That is, in respect of Aries sign, the counting will be Aries, Taurus, Gemini and upto the lord of Aries (i.e. Mars). The farther is the position of Mars from Aries sign, the longer will be the period of the Chara Dasa of this sign. In case of Cancer sign, which is in the even quarter, the counting would be in the reverse order and restricted upto its lord viz., the Moon. The scheme of counting will be Cancer, Gemini, Taurus, till it reaches the position of the Moon in the natal chart.

units.verse_devanagari:

units.translation:
158-166 : Now I explain how to decide the Dasa-years of the signs having the dual lordship. O Brahmin! If both the lords are conjunct and located in their own signs, 12 years be assigned, otherwise Dasa-years be ascertained on the basis of single lord-ship. In case, one lord is in its own sign and other one is in a different sign, the counting of years be restricted upto the latter one (if the lords are posited in different signs). In the event of both the lords being located in different signs, O-Brahmin, the forward or reverse counting should be in respect of the planet which is stronger. The concept of relative strength over here means that the lord which is accompanying a planet is stronger than the one without it. If both have equal number of planets, the decision will rest on the basis of the strength of the signs. The sequence is that the fixed sign from the movable sign and the dual sign from the fixed sign is more powerful. If the signs also be of the same type, the sign rendering higher number of years be considered for Chara Dasa. Here, if one planet is in the exaltation sign and the other one is contributing higher number of years, the former (the one of exaltation sign) be considered. Besides, one year be added for the planet in the exaltation and one year be deducted if it is in the state of debilitation.
The results of the Chara Dasa be analysed after due deliberation on these lines.
units.commentary:
Notes : Shloka 157 describes the dual lordship of Mars and Ketu in respect of Scorpio sign and of Saturn and Rahu for Aquarius sign in the scheme of Chara Dasa. Only these two signs are having lordship of two planets over it. The method of fixing the Chara Dasa for these two signs is briefly explained as under :-
i) If both the lords of the sign are located in the sign owned by them (i.e. Scorpio containing Mars and Ketu and Aquarius having Saturn and Rahu in it) the period of the sign be record as 12 years. ii) If one planet is in his own sign and the other one is else where, the counting be done upto the planet posited in the other sign. iii) In case both the planets are in different signs, the counting should proceed upto the planet, stronger of the two. The method for the identification of the stronger planet has also been enunciated by Maharishi in his aphorism to set right the imbrogilo in this process. According to maxim, the planet which is conjoined with other planets is considered stronger than the one without it. If both the lords of the sign are having company of the planets, the planet with more planets will be stronger. Finally, if the number of the conjunct planets with the lords also happens to be the same, the comparative strength of these signs holding these lords will solve this entanglement. iv) The strength of the signs is reckoned on the basis of the nature of the sign (viz., movable, fixed or dual). Fixed sign from movable and dual sign from fixed sign is considered powerful. v) Here again if both happen to be the signs of the same nature, the sign accommodating the lord contributing more number of years in the Dasa, should be reckoned. Vi) In a situation where amongst the two sign-lords, one is exalted and the other is not, then the exalted planet will have priority over the other inspite of the fact, the second planet is contributing more number of years in the Dasa. Sequel to this is that the Dasa of exalted planet will have one added year while the Dasa of the debilitated planet is deprived of by one year. Some of the eminent Astrologers are of the view that one should not resort to addition or substraction on account of sign getting exalted or debilitated respectively. Through sustained applications of this maxim, they observed that unaltered Dasa years do give the desired results. It is found that Jupiter when posited in Capricorn, the Dasa of the Sagittarius sign becomes void (1-1=0) with the substraction of one year due to Jupiter being in debilitation. Similarly, if Mercury is housed in Virgo, the Dasa of Virgo sign shows 13 years (12+1) which does not fit in the scheme. These cited anomalies leave enough scope for the scholars and students of the astrology alike to ponder over this dilemma and form there own opinion on this issue.

units.translation: 16-17: Kalachakra Dasa of Leo : In Scorpio-Navamsa, conflicts and distress; in Libra-Navamsa, good gains; in Virgo-Navamsa, sumptuous gains; in the Cancer-Navamsa, obstacles from the forestry animals like deer; in Leo-Navamsa, birth of a child; in Gemini-Navamsa, increase of enemies; in Tarurus-Navamsa, profit from animals; in Aries-Navamsa, danger from the animals and in Pisces-Navamsa, long journies (domestic). These are the results of the Dasas of the Navamsa sign of Leo Kalachakra Dasa.
units.commentary:
Notes: In the period of Scorpio Navamsa of Leo Dasa, one develops irritation and at time gets aggressive behaviour. But there will be tremendous amount of agility and enthusiasm. In the Libra-Navamsa, the native gets totally engrossed in his business activities. Whatever help he seeks at the government level, he gets it easily. In the period of Virgo-Navamsa, accumulation of wealth, purchase of ornaments and also purchase of fixed assets which are likely to be inherited by his children in future. In the period of Cancer-Navamsa, danger from the forestry animals is stated. However; it is also observed that there would be danger from the water reptiles and animals and reptiles dwelling in the burrows. In the Leo-Navamsa, a birth of a child (if there is desire for one will definitly be there). If Saturn is posited in Leo sign, there is danger of sickness for a achild. But if Mars and Jupiter are in Leo sign, the child will be quite intelligent. In the period of Gemini-Navamsa, the native has to suffer minimum of three types of diseases.
In the period of Taurus-Navamsa, there will be a possibility of getting an agency of an enterprise. In Aries-Navamsa, injuries from the pet animals is there. In the Navamsa of Pisces period, foreign travels will be on card. There will be opportunities of sea voyage and chances of export business through sea routes.

units.translation: 17-18 : A query held in the fist or thought of, will relate to Dhatu (article of the metal, mineral origin), if the planet (in a query chart) occupying its own Navamsa and aspects its own Navamsa in the Ascendant or in the trinal house. But, if the planet (in the same case) occupies the Navamsa of another planet and then aspects its own Navamsa in the Ascendant or in the trinal houses, the query will relate to Jeeva (matter connected with living beings). If the planet be in another's Navamsa and also aspects another's Navamsa in the Ascendant or in the trnal houses, the query will refer to Moola (some roots or vegetables kind). In the case of even signs, if the Ascendant is located in the 1st Navamsa, the query will relate to Jeeva; in the 2nd Navamsa, Moola; in the 3rd Navamsa, it will concern Dhatu. Again, the 4th, the 5th, the 6th Navamsas will relate to Jeeva, Moola and Dhatu respectively. (Further, the 7th, the 8th and the 9th Navamsas will repeat the order). In the case of Ascendant be in the odd sign and is located in the 1st Navamsa, the fist query will relate to Dhatu, the 2nd Navamsa, Moola and the 3rd Navamsa, will refer to Jeeva. Similarly, the remaining six Navamsas of the odd sign will repeat twice.
units.commentary: Notes : The fist or thought of queries were generally used to test the skill of the Astrologers by the kings inthe ancient time. The foregoing stanza contains the method of delineating of the three types of queries which relate to (i) Dhatu, (ii) Jeeva and (iii) Moola. From these methods, it is possible to determine whether the object or subject matter held in the fist or thought of, is of a Dhatu, Moola or Jeeva kind. The principles, enunciated in this Shloka, are reiterated hereafter for the benefit of the readers. If any planet occupying a Navamsa of its own, aspects a Navamsa of its own in the Ascendant, the 5th or the 9th house, it should be stated that the querist is thinking about Dhatu such as gold, silver, steel etc. The Mars is posited in its own Navamsa (20° in Libra) and also aspecting its own Navamsa in the Ascendant (3°-Aries). If the planet is occupying the Navamsa of another planet but is aspecting the own Navamsa in the Ascendant or the trinal houses (the 5th or the 9th), the query will relate to Jeeva

units.translation: 17-19: Features of Malavya Yoga : The native having the Malavya Yoga possesses beauteous lips, slim waist, splendour alike Moon, body emitting special fragrance, normal reddish complexion, medium height, uniform and neat teeth, voice resembling elephant's loud cry (trumpet i.e. deep thick voice), elongated arms, length of face 13 and breadth 10 Agulas (अंगुल). After attaining the rulership of sindh and Malwa and experiencing comforts and happiness for 70 years, he departs from this world for heavenly abode.
units.commentary:
Notes: This Yoga is created when Venus duly conjoined with Taurus, Libra or Pisces sign is located in an Agular house. Malavya is a kind of Yoga which gets formed with every Ascendant. For delineating results of this yoga, certain precautions are necessarily to be observed. Some of these are appended as under : i) It is said that the lord of the 2nd and the 7th houses is posited in 2nd or 7th house becomes Markesha. This principle tends to cause some kind of doubt about the efficacy of this yoga in case of Aries and Scorpio Ascendants, because the Antardasa of Venus may inflict death and the native when having this thing in store, how can he enjoy material comforts? However, it is our humble submission that one should not rush through in declaring this result unless he has meticulously ascertained the longevity of the native. It is also necessary to know whether Venus is under the influence of any malefic planets or not. Even though Venus is being influenced by the malefic planets and if the native has a good longevity, this period will pass away merely causing some kind of physical distress which however, will not leave any telling effects. ii) Malavya Yoga in Aries Ascendant confers marriage or love with a woman, wealth, family comforts, prosperity, accretion of wealth, progress in the vocation of the children or business tours etc. While the Scorpio Ascendant no doubt, gives marriage or woman's love but it also causes heavy expenditure. The business tours are by and large, remain unsuccessful. The relations with the partner and relatives become estranged. Wife may contract some disease. Depletion of wealth may also be observed. iii) The Antardasa of Venus in Cancer Ascendant does cause sufferings but Venus being the lord of an Angular house, the effect gets neutralised and the results of the lord of the 11th house becomes more pronounced which according to Maharishi is of malefic nature. iv) The Antardasa of Venus in Libra Ascendant does cause some physical sufferings but of an ordinary nature. However, in Taurus Ascendant, the intensity of sufferings is more severe because with this Ascendant, Venus attains the lordship of the 1st house (body) and the 6th house (disease). However, good results relating to financial matters are not experienced in both these Ascendants. In Libra Ascendant, if Venus gets the association of the lords of auspicious houses, it may confer success specifically in the worldly matters but in Taurus Ascendant, with whatever house Venus establishes its connection, the native would get involved in litigation relating to the signification of that particular house.
v) Malavya Yoga delineates specific results in Capricorn and Aquarius Ascendants provided Venus forms connections with the lords of auspicious houses. In these Ascendants, Venus becomes Yogakarakas being the lord of Angular and Trinal houses.
vi) Formation of Malavya Yoga in Gemini and Virgo Ascendants, the signs of Mercury, its results are excellent. In this case if Venus has connection with the lord of any Angular houses through conjunction or aspect etc., the results would be par excellent because this relationship would be amongst the Yogakaraka planets. Malavya Yoga in Gemini Ascendant makes the native intelligent and he will have good earnings in instructional vocation (teaching, disseminating knowledge etc.) but in Virgo Ascendant, the native will get success in the business activities.
vii) To get material happiness in Sagittarius and Pisces Ascendants by Malavya Yoga would be quite doubtful because Venus over here acquires ownership of auspicious houses. However, in Pisces Ascendant, when Venus forms certain particular connections with some lords of the houses, the results of some favourable events or attributes are observed. units.translation: 17-20: Maharishi Parasara said, O Brahmin! If Rahu excepting in the Ascendant (Lagna) is posited in an Angle (Kendra) or a Trine (Trikona) from the lord of Ascendant (Lagna lord), some learneds adopt Astottari Dasa system. The Astottari Dasa commences with the Sun Dasa covering four Nakshatras with Ardra being the first one. Three Nakshatras thereafter are assigned to the Moon. Next four go to Mars followed by three Nakshatras for Mercury Dasa. Again, next four Nakshatras are entrusted to Saturn Dasa which is succeeded by Jupiter Dasa with subsequent three Nakshatras. Rahu Dasa comes next with four and last is the Dasa of Venus with three left over Nakshatras. (These planets are the lord of the Nakshatras which are under their fold). The ruling Dasa lord is determined through counting in the above order upto the birth Nakshatra. O Brahmin! Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Saturn, Jupiter, Rahu and Venus are the Dasa lords. Excepting Ketu, all the other planets are covered in this system. The Dasa period starting from the Sun is 6, 15, 8, 17, 10, 19, 12 and 21 years respectively.
units.commentary:
Notes : The Astottari Dasa system is mainly practised in the Eastern and North-Eastern part of the country. The eminent Astrologers of these parts, rely more on Astottari system rather than any other Dasa, (Except Vimsottari Dasa system which has its own place in these parts also) the astrologers though of the opinon that in 'Kalyuga', Vimsottari Dasa system is more efficient than Astottari. There is unanimity on the fact that if the native is born in Shukla Paksha, (brighter half of the lunar course) the prediction should be done through Vimsottari Dasa and for the birth during Krishna Paksha, (darker half of the lunar course) Asttotari Dasa system be employed.
Astottari Dasa has 108 years cycle and Ketu is not in the scheme of things. However, Abhijita Nakshatra has been included and as such 28 Nakshatras are operative in this system. It may, however, be noted that Abhijita has no independent status. The span (arc or length of operation) of Abhijita Nakshatra constitues of the last quarter of Uttar Ashada and first 1/15th part of Shravana Nakshatras. One Nakshatra has an arc of 13°-20' (800'). With the contribution of Uttar Ashada and Shravana Nakshatra, the arc of Abhijita works out as under : Consequently, the arc of Uttara Ashada and Shravana Nakshatras gets reduced to :
Uttara Ashada = 800' - 200' = 600' - 00"
Shravana = 800 - (53-20') = 746' - 40" The native is said to have been born in Uttar Ashada if the birth is in the first three quarters of the Nakshatra. Similarly, the birth will be considered, in Shravana Nakshatra and if it is after 53' - 20" of the Ist quarter of the Nakshatra. When birth occurs in the gap of 253' - 20" between Uttara Ashada and Shravana Nakshatras, the native supposed to have taken birth in Abhijita Nakshatra. The Bhayaata and Bhabhoga of these three Nakshatras should be worked out keeping these factors in view.

units.translation: 171-173 : Maharishi Parasara replied; "The strongest lord amongst 6th, 8th or 12th house reckoned from the Ascendant or 7th house (the house holding more strength) and posited in an odd sign and also located within 6 signs from the Ascendant or 7th house (the one being considered) is called Brahma-Graha. The lord of the 8th house from Karaka (Atmakarka) and posited in 8th house is also taken as Bramha. Amongst the Saturn, Rahu or Ketu which ever is being picked up as Brahma-Graha and 6th lord there from is also called Brahma. If more than one planets is getting approved as Bramha, the one with greater longitude be reckoned as Bramha-Graha. In the event of longitude being identical, the stronger one be considered.
units.commentary:
Notes : In Sthira Dasa system, the period of each Dasa is fixed one Such as movable signs 7 years, fixed 8 years and dual get 9 years. The Dasa of the native begins from the sign housing the Brahma-Graha. In the event of such sign being odd, the counting of the Dasa-sign will be in successive order and for even signs, it will be in the reverse order. For the nomination of the Brahama-Graha, first of all, the stronger house between the Ascendant and 7th house is to be decided. There are different basis for the identification of the strength of the house. These are as follows :- i) The house with a planet in it, is stronger than the house without it.
ii) If both the houses have the planets, the higher numerical number will decide the issue.
iii) Suppose, if both the houses are posited with the equal number of planets, any house with an exalted planet becomes powerful.
iv) If both the houses are devoid of planets, the position of the lord of the house in respect to their exaltation point be the deciding factor.
v) Even after this much exercise, if both the planets turn out to be holding equal strength, the planet with the higher degree of longitude be considered as stronger.
vi) Suppose, even then, the parity amongst the contesting planets exist, the following steps may necessarily be taken for a split decision :
a) Between these two odd signs, the lord of the one which is in the even sign is considerd stronger.
b) Like wise, amongst these even sign, the sign having its lord in the odd sign, becomes stronger. vii) Inspite of all this painstaking analysis, the dead lock still persists, the criterion of natural strength of the planet may be adopted. Suppose if their longitudes are also the same which is a rarest possibility, the natural strength of the planet shall decide the issue. units.verse_devanagari:
लग्नसप्तमयोर्मध्ये यो राशिर्बलवान् भवेत् ।
ततः केन्द्रादि-संस्थानां राशीनाञ्च बलक्रमात् ।। १७५ ।।
कारकादपि राशीनां खेटानां चैवमेव हि ।
दशाब्दाश्चरवज्ज्ञेयाः खेटानां च स्वभावधि ।। १७६ ।।
units.translation: 175-176 : From the Ascendant or 7th house whichever is stronger, the Dasa of the signs of Angles (Kendra) etc., in their relative strength order are reckoned. [If the sign of the Ascendant or 7th house (what ever will be the case) is odd, the sequence of the Dasas will be in progression and if it is an even sign, the Dasas sequence will be in a reverse manner for the signs located in Kendra (Angles), Panapharas (Succedent), Apoklimas (Cadent) houses. The Dasa order will be in accordance to the comparative strength of the sign.] In the same manner, the Dasa of the signs and planets be considered from Atmakarka also. The scheme of fixing the span of Dasa in Chara Dasa system as well be adopted in this case. The Dasa period (years) of the planets is ascertained through counting upto their respective signs.
units.commentary:
Notes : Kendra Dasa is also a kind of Dasa. In order to work out the Kendra Dasa, one has first of all to pick up stronger house between the Ascendant and the 7th house. If the Ascendant happens to be the stronger one, the signs of Angles therefrom will have first set of Dasas. However, the sequence of Dasa amongst them will be based on the comparative strength of the sign. This set of Dasa will be followed by the signs of the Panaphara houses and last set of Dasas will be of the signs of the Apoklima houses. These Dasa squence, will also be arranged in the same manner. If the Ascendant is having an odd sign, forward counting and if even sign, the reverse counting of the Dasa-sign for Kendra, Panphera and Apoklima house will be resorted to. The same principle is adopted in the combination of Atmakaraka and the 7th house. The stronger one will take the lead and Dasa cycle is drawn in the similar fashion. This Dasa is of two kinds (i) Kendradi Dasa (ii) Karka-Kendradi Dasa. Even in this, some kind of difference exists between Kendradi-Sign Dasa and Kendra-Planet Dasa. Appropos procedure relates to Kendra sign Dasa. The pattern of Kendra-Planet Dasa is also near about the same as planets instead of signs are taken into consideration over here. For fixing the period (years) of the Dasas, Maharishi Parasara described it by saying "दशाब्दाश्चरवज्ज्ञेया:" which means that the Dasa period (years) be identical to Chara Dasa years. In the illustrated horoscope, the 7th house is stronger than the Ascendant (for logic, please see example 11). Consequently, the serial of Dasas will begin from the 7th house and in reverse order, as the 7th sign is even sign. In that order, the first Angle sign is Aries then Capricorn and lastly Libra sign. Since, 7th lord Moon is located in Aries, the Dasa will commence from Aries. Between Capricorn and Libra signs, the Dasa of the sign will come next whose lord has higher longitude. The signs of the Panaphara houses from the 7th house are (in severse order) Gemini, Pisces, Sagittarius and Virgo. The Dasas of these signs will be serialed on the basis of these comparative strength. It comes to Pisces, Virgo, Sagittarius and Gemini. The sign Dasas of the Apoklima houses with respect to the 7th house are Taurus, Aquarius, Scorpio and Leo and in the sequence of Taurus, Aquarius, Leo, Scorpio Dasas.
The total number of years in respect of each Dasa should be determined on the basis of Chara Dasa system. The Cancer sign being of even group, the total years will be 3 (4-1) i.e. by counting in the reverse order from the 7th house to the sign in which the 7th lord Moon is posited. Similarly, the Dasa periods (years) of the other signs may be determined.
In the same manner, amongst Atmakarka, the Moon, lord of Aries and the 7th sign, the Aries sign is more powerful. This is an odd sign, hence, the Dasa will start from Aries sign itself. Thereafter, the Dasas of the signs of Kendra, Panaphara and Apoklima houses be determined. Atmakaraka Moon is posited in Aries sign which is an odd sign. Therefore, forward sequence will start from Aries in the context of Kendra, Panaphara and Apoklima houses and the Dasas of the planets located in these houses will follow the sequence depending upon their comparative strength.
Like, the Moon is in Aries, hence first Dasa will be that of the Moon and next planet in Angle from Aries, is only Venus and the Dasa of Venus will come next. The planets located in the Panaphara houses from the Moon (in the direct order) are Sun, Mercury, Mars, Ketu and Rahu. Since first three planets are together, the determination of three order will be on the longitudinal basis and the sequence will be Sun, Mars and Mercury. This will be followed by Ketu and Rahu Dasas.
The planets in Apoklima house from the Moon are only Saturn and Jupiter. On the basis of their strength, Jupiter comes first succeeded by Saturn.
The span of the Dasas of these planets is equal to the number (in terms of years) between the planets and their respective signs. Hence, the Dasa-span of Moon is 3 (4-1) years when counted in the reverse order upto Cancer (even sign). On the same lines, the Dasa-span in respect of planets may be measured. However, the sequence of the Dasas will remain the same.
As stated earlier, in the determination of the Dasa of a planet, the counting should always commence from the planet to its respective sign. However, some astrological scholars are of the opinion that the counting should be from the sign to its planet (lords). This concept does not seem to hold water because the exposition of Kendradi-Dasa over here is purely in context with the maxim of Maharishi Parasara which is at variance with the Jaimini's aphorism.

units.verse_devanagari:
मण्डूकापरपर्याया त्रिकूटाख्यदशा द्विज ! ।
लग्नसप्तमयोर्मध्ये यो राशिर्बलवान् भवेत् ।।१७९ ।।
ततः क्रमेणौजराशौ समे नेया तथोत्क्रमात् ।
त्रिकूटानां च विज्ञेयाः स्थिरवच्च दशा समाः ।।१८० ।।
units.translation: 179-180 : O Brahmin! The ancient Astrologers used the name of Trikoota Dasa for Mandooka Dasa. Dasa in this system, emanates from the strongest amongst the Ascendant and the 7th house and sequence of the Dasas is in the forward or in the reverse order depending upon the sign being of odd or even nature. The period (years) of the Dasa are in line with the Sthira Dasa system (i.e., for movable signs-7 years, fixed signs 8 years and for dual signs 9 years). In this Dasa scheme, the counting pattern is to relinquish two signs in between every time (i.e. Jumping over two signs) and for this very reason it is called Mandooka Dasa.
units.commentary: Notes : In fixing the Mandooka Dasa, like in some of the preceding Dasas, stronger amongst the Ascendant and as 7th house sets the sequence of the Dasa. In our earlier examples of the standard horoscope, the 7th house reckoned as stronger than the Ascendant. The 7th house sign is Cancer with Venus in it. Since Cancer is an even sign, the Dasa pattern will be in the reverse order. As the maxim goes after the first Dasa of Cancer the next Dasa will be of the third sign after skipping the two signs in the reverse order viz., Aries Dasa, next Capricorn and thereafter the Dasa of Libra will come. The Dasa period (years) are like Sthira Dasa system. The Cancer sign being a movable sign, each Dasa will be of 7 years duration. On the completion of first cycle of movable signs, the next round of Dasas will be of dual signs starting from Gemini, Pisces, Sagittarius and Virgo with the duration of 8 years each. Lastly, Dasa serial of dual signs will follow in the order; Taurus, Aquarius, Scorpio and Leo sign of 9 years duration of each Dasa. Maharishi Parasara has attributed 7 yrs; 8 yrs ; and 9 yrs; to Movable. Fixed and Dual signs respectively while Rishi Jaimini reckoned 9 years identically for all the signs.

units.translation: 181-182 : Some astrological Savants consider Shoola Dasa for ascertaining the timing of death. The eighth house from the Ascendant or the 7th house i.e. the 2nd house, which ever is stronger will lead the Dasa order into motion. The sequence of the twelve signs will be in the forward or in the reverse order depending upon the leading sign being odd or even. The Dasas years are identical to those in the Sthira Dasa system. Death possibly occurs in the Dasa of strong Capricorn sign.
units.commentary: Notes : Shoola Dasa is also known as Niryana Shoola Dasa. Maharishi Parasara has adopted an identical Dasa-span of the signs of the Sthir-Dasa even for the Shoola-Dasa system though Rishi Jaimini considered 9 years for all the signs of the Dasa. In the exampled horoscope, Rahu and Ketu are posited in the 2nd and the 8th house respectively and as such it is not possible to ascertain the comparative strength of these signs. On the basis of longitudinal difference, the lord of the 8th house, the Sun is more powerful then Saturn, the lord of the 2nd house. Consequently, the counting will commence from the 8th house. The Sun being in an odd sign, forward count will be resorted to. The sequence of 12 signs emanating from Leo will end at Cancer sign. This is what will be the Shoola Dasa (signs) cycle.

units.translation: 19-21: If Rahu is in Angle or Trine or the 3rd or the 11th house from the lord of the 10th house, native receives benefits of the pilgrimage of the holy shrines, perception of deity, develops inclination towards benevolent works, religious, sacred and pious deeds. units.translation: 2-3: If one house contains four planets duly strong, it will give rise to a Yoga which will cause asceticism (abandonment of temparal concerns). Amongst these planets, if the Sun is strong, the native will be a Tapasvi (तपस्वी), a contemplative ascetic; should the Moon be strong, the person becomes a Kapali (कपाली) - a man with beggar's bowl; if Mars being strong, the person will adorn red clothes; with Mercury being strong, he will possess a staff (दण्डा); incase Jupiter gets stronger, he will be a Yati (यती) - and ascetic (Pravrajya) abstinent and severe in self-discipline; should Venus be strong, he will be the possessor of Chakra (चक्रधारी); in case Saturn be strong, he becomes Naga (नागा) - the one who moves about in nude forms. In the event of many planets come out to be strong, the native will embrace asceticism on the basis of the strongest planet amongst them.
units.commentary: Notes : Infact the inclination towards asceticism is nothing but the mental make up of a person or a particular state of mind. For the fructification of Pravrajya Yoga, the 4th house becomes more relavent. The 4th house and its lord, the Moon that signifies the mind and if malefic planets like Saturn or the Sun or the lord of the 12th house (मोक्ष स्थान) have the overbearing influence in the nativity, the Yoga of asceticism (संन्यास) gets fructified. Some learned Astrologers may not agree for the involvement of the 12th house and the lord of the 12th house and this disagreement may due to the fact that the 12th house signifies bed comforts (sexual connections), but this is a traditional interpretation and which is not derived etymologically. If we understand this disposition in a broad sense, it stands to mean as Yoga (योग) for combining, meeting, making pair or for that matter, mating. Our ancient have also described this house as मोक्ष स्थान - final emancipation. Maharish Parasara's contention of having four or more planets in one house is confined to the fact that they should be within the space (orb) of one degree. If they are apart by more than one degree in one sign, it will not form Pravrajya Yoga.

units.translation: 2-4: During the Dasa of the lord of the Ascendant, the native enjoys sound health, high fame, etc.; in the Dasa of the lord of the second house, conflicts, fear of death and in the Dasa of the lord of the third house, unfavourable results be anticipated. In the Dasa of the lord of fourth house, luxury of house and land (property); in the Dasa of the lord of the fifth house, progress in education and pleasure of children and in the sixth house's lord Dasa, physical sufferings and danger from the enemies be described.
units.commentary:
Notes : In the Dasa of the Asendant's lord, the native is blessed with good health, free from any kind of illness because the Ascendant represents body of the native. No doubt this text has special importance, but we have also to inevitably analyse the position and the strength of the Ascendant. In case, the lord of the Ascendant is in the enemy's sign, the resistance of the body gets reduced and the native may have an attack of some disease and with the result, the body will suffer. If the lord of the Ascendant is in debilitation, the damage in the body is more pronounced. One may get hurt in a sudden accident, go into depression, feel deranged or lethargic etc. If the lord of the Ascendant is heading towards debilitation (Avrohi) during the illness, the native suddenly loses weight and his condition will get deterioted day by day. If per chance, the Ascendant lord also receives affliction in transit, the condition may get worst. The following states (Avasthas) of the lord of the Ascendant which tend to take the native towards old age, rather quickly:
i) If it is heading towards debilitation (Avrohi)
ii) If it is in the debilitation.
iii) If it is having connection with the 8th Lord.
[Like, (a) conjuct with the 8th lord, (b) the 8th lord posited in the Ascendant, c) Ascendant and the 8th lord in the 6th or the 12th house]. Therefore, if the lord of the ascendant is found in any of these three states in the nativity, the Mahadasa of the Ascendant lord will persistently affect the health of the native and he remains in the grip of sickness. The Ascendant lord if is also connected with the lord of the 2nd, the 7th, the 6th or the 12th house, ever then one may face illness during its Dasa. In the state of debilitation, the lord of the Ascendant in its Dasa makes the native mentally deranged. If there is any retrograde malefic planet in the 2nd house from the Ascendant lord which also has a malefic planet behind it (in 12th house), the Antradasas of these two malefic planets in the Mahadasa of the Ascendant lord will set in some serious disease (relating to the body). If the Ascendant lord is posited in a malefic Sashtamsa, defeated in the planetary war, in the last Amsa of a fixed sign, in the young or the old age of the lord of 22nd Drekkana, Gulika, Mandi or 64th Navamsa, moving towards the sign of debilitation, it will also be hazardous to the health of the native. Apart from bodily sufferings, a weak Ascendant lord is responsible for unethical acts, defame, loss of pride, arrogance, cruelty, insult etc. In addition, the results of the Dasa of the lord of the Ascendant will vary in accordance to the different rising signs (Ascendants). The Ascendant lord, if strong and connected with the auspicious houses and benefic lord of a house, during its Dasa, native attains fame, comforts, smartness, exaltation, pride, politeness, beauty, sound health, praise, soft behaviour etc. In the Dasa of the lord of the 2nd house, fear of conflicts and death that the native may grapple with, but these results are far fetched one. the 2nd and the 7th houses are the "Maraka Sthanas". The 2nd house has greater propensity than the 7th house. The 2nd lord if get conjunct with and have any kind of connection with the malefic planets or there are malefic planets posited in the 2nd house, the Dasa of the lord of 2nd house is reckoned as Maraka Dasa. The 2nd lord if has even ordinary affliction, it brings about conflicts in day to day dealings. The reasons for such conflicts may vary in each time. In the Dasa of a strong and auspicious 2nd lord, the native accumulates wealth and creats assets. He also buys gold and ornaments and has a bank locker registered in his name. With whichever house or house lord, the lord of the 2nd house establishes its connections, the native will acquire wealth connected with the signification of that house and house lord. The Sage considers the third house as malefic and inauspicus house. Therefore, the Dasa of the 3rd lord renders malefic results. During this Dasa, the native plans about his business activities and makes efforts for its accomplishment. The native is very exertive and struggles his ways through for the attainments of his ventures during the Dasa of the 3rd lord. Should the lord of the 3rd house be powerful, the native gets success of his laborius attempts and sustained efforts, otherwise, his struggle will end in futility. In the event of 3rd house lord being strong, the native will also gain weight and if this Dasa falls in the young age of the native, he develops lot of strength and dignity. He inculcates the habits of hard working and making profit. He gets affectionate towards his co-borns. He will undertake lot of business and pleasure tourings. The division of ancestral property also generally takes place during this Dasa. The native will leave no stone unturned for the achievement of his ambitions. In the Dasa of the 4th house lord, if it is strong and well placed, the native achieves high position in the society, attains popularity, acquires conveyance, constructs house, gains in the agricultural field and cattle etc. If 4th lord happened to be weak, the adverse effects may be expected. The Dasa of the strong and well placed lord of the 5th house, the native will get maturity in his thinkings and will undertake the work in all seriousness and use his wisdom and foresight. The native will get success in big venture. He also develops his acquaintances with the ladies of high status. In case the native is a writer, he will write his great works during this period that because in this time, one has full concentration of his mind and consequently, he can put heart and soul in such ventures. Therefore, it is in this period that the native could be conferred with some recognised award for his works. The Dasa of a weak lord of the 5th house will give reverse results. The results of the Dasa of the lord of the 6th house as experienced by the humble author are like this; the native develops estranged relation with his relatives and known persons. The native experiences stresses and strains. He takes loans and able to return the same but if 6th lord is weak, the native will face extreme difficulties and there will be some delays in returning the loans. However, during this period, the native can earn through work (labour) force. In the event of 6th lord being weak, he may face confrontations with the labour and gets his work done after encountering one obstacle after another.

units.verse_devanagari:
साधु पृष्टं त्वया विप्र ! तदपि प्रवदाम्यहम् ।
स्त्रीणां पुंभिः समं ज्ञेयं फलमुक्तं विपश्चिता ।। २ ।।
विशेषस्तत्र यो दृष्टः संक्षेपात् कथयामि तत् ।
लग्ने देहफलं तस्याः पञ्चमे प्रसवस्तथा ।। ३ ।।
सप्तमे पतिसौभाग्यं वैधव्यं निधने द्विज ।
स्त्रीणामसम्भवं यच्च तत्फलं तत्पतौ वदेत् ।। ४ ।।
units.translation: 2-4: Maharishi Parasara replied - O Vipra ! You have posed a very good question. I will explain the same as well. What all results relating to the male horoscope which have been narrated so far, be also considered for the female horoscope. However, what are special to the female horoscopy, the same are briefly , being described over here. The attributes related to her Deha (देह - physical traits, body etc.) should be reckoned from the 1st house (Ascendant), the birth from the 5th house, husband from the 7th house and widowhood be ascertained from the 8th house. Those results which are not possible to occur for a female, the same be stated for her husband.
units.commentary: Notes: The fortune (सौभाग्य) of the husband and widowhood of a woman should be analysed from the 7th and 8th houses respectively from her nativity. This is what, Maharishi has indicated in the above Shlokas. The 7th house denotes the husband. This house is reckoned as the Ascendant for the husband. Besides, the Ascendant not only signifies the body as expounded in these Shlokas but also stands for general happiness, sorrows, knowledge (prudence), place of birth, fame, strength, glory, honour, kingship, politeness, longevity, solace, general appearance, prestige, behaviour, sound health, vocation, childhood, adulthood, old age etc. The learned Astrologers have also reckoned the other Karkatwas of the Ascendant as to forsake things (त्याग), character of the native, shortcomings, various Avasthas (dignity of planets) etc. Therefore, from the 7th house in the woman's nativity (taken as the Ascendant for her husband), it is quite appropriate to analyse the characteristics of the husband of the native. Positioning of benefic planets in the 7th house, makes the woman as most fortunate. In the birth chart of a woman, if the dignified Sun is posited in the 7th house, and it (the Sun) does not form any kind of connections with the malefic planets like Rahu, Saturn etc., such female native gets married in a high class family. In Chapter-1 of the Shloka 14 of Phaldeepika, it is stated that the Sobhagya (सौभाग्य) of the woman (husband's fortune), whether he is alive or not, should be delineated from the 8th house. Further, in accordance to the Shlokas 5 and 6 of Jataka Parijata (Chapter XVI), the longevity of the husband of a woman should be judged from the 8th house only. Therefore, to analyse the widowhood of a female from the 8th house is rather more appropriate. This is the

units.verse_devanagari:
षष्ठाष्टमव्यये जीवे नीचे वास्तंगते सति ।।२०।।
पापग्रहेण संयुक्ते दृष्टे वा दुर्बले सति ।
चौराहिनृपभीतिश्च पित्तरोगादिसम्भवम् ।।२१।। प्रेतबाधा भृत्यनाशः सोदराणां विनाशनम् ।
द्वितीयद्यूननाथे तु ह्यपमृत्युज्वरादिकम् ।।
तद्दोषपरिहारार्थं शिवसाहस्रकं जपेत् ।।२२।।
units.translation: 20-22: If Jupiter is posited in the 6th, the 8th or the 12th house from the lord of the Mahadasa or being in the sign of debilitation or combust and get conjunctive with or aspected by the malefic planets or devoid of strength, during the Antardasa of Jupiter, in the Mahadasa of Mars, there will be fear of serpent, the king or theft, possibility of the eruption of biles disease; obstacles in love affairs. Loss of Job and brothers. Should Jupiter be the lord of the 2nd or the 7th house, untimely death, fever etc., may be caused. To alleviate the adverse effects, recitation of Lord Shiva Sahastranama be observed.
units.commentary: Notes: Jupiter acquiring the lordship of the 9th house and the placement as narrated in the proceeding stanza will indicate the possibility of Jaundice. Here is an illustration. Data : Date of birth; 26-5-1989; Time of birth 13-30 hrs; (IST) Latitude; 28°-43' (N); Longitude 77°-47' (E) The native contracted Jaundice in the Mahadasa of Mars and in the Antardasa of Jupiter and on account of which, the child had to undergo blood transfusion. During that period both the Sun and Jupiter were transiting Taurus at 11°-21' and 21°-34' respectively. Jupiter being combust was at 12th house from the natal Mars. Satum which causes disease is in the sign of Jupiter (natal chart) duly aspected by Mars. Therefore, the Moolatrikona sign of Jupiter has been intensively afflicted. Trimsamsa Chart is placed above. Here Jupiter is the lord of the 6th house and placed in the sign of Saturn which is having a conjunction with the Mars. At birth, the balance Dasa was that of the Moon as 4 years, 0 month, 4 days.

units.verse_devanagari:
सौम्यस्यान्तर्गते सूर्ये स्वोच्चे स्वक्षेत्रकेन्द्रगे ।
त्रिकोणे धनलाभे तु तुंगांशे स्वांशगेऽपि वा ।। २० ।।
राजप्रसादसौभाग्यं मित्रप्रभुवशात्सुखम् ।
भूम्यात्मजेन संदृष्टे आदौ भूलाभमादिशेत् ।। २१ ।।
लग्नाधिपेन संदृष्टे बहुसौख्यं धनागमम् ।
ग्रामभूम्यादिलाभं च भोजनाम्बरसौख्यकृत् ।। २२ ।।
units.translation: 20-22: In the Mahadasa of Mercury and the Antardasa of the Sun, if the Sun is posited in its own sign or sign of exaltation or in Trine, in the 2nd, the 11th or in the exalted or own Navamsa, it will manifest results like pleasure of the king; increase in fortune; comforts of Master (employer) and friends. If the Sun is under the aspect of Mars, in the beginning of the Antardasa, there will be gain of property (land etc.) and if the Sun gets the aspect of the lord of the Ascendant, it will confer ample happiness, wealth, village (big estate), land and comfort of food and clothes etc.
units.commentary: Notes : Sagittarius Ascendant is the only such Ascendant in which both Mercury and the Sun become Yogakaraka. Although in the Taurus Ascendant, the association and conjunction of both these planets give good results but in the Dasas of these planets, there is some difference in their results. In the Sagittarius Ascendant, the native attains a good status, and in the case of Taurus Ascendant, one gets popularity and felicitation, land, vehicle etc. and other material comforts. In other Ascendants, there would be mixed results (good or bad) even though the birth charts may be highly potential and held good promises. Here is a typical horoscope of a native who has been elected in the allied services of I.A.S. (Indian Administrative Service) during the Antardasa of the Sun and Mahadasa of Mercury. In the birth chart, the Sun being the lord of the 9th house is posited in the 10th house and Mercury is in the 11th house alongwith its lord Venus. The 11th house also signifies Income Tax Department. Although the Sun is at 12th house from Mercury, he is both dispositor of Mars and also the lord of the 9th house (fortune). The Sun is very powerful in Shadabala (8.13 Rupa) so is Mercury (8.79 Rupa). The highlight of this nativity is that their planets viz., the Sun and Mercury have acquired highest Shadabalas amongst the planets and both of them form Yogakaraka between them. Since the Sun is the significator of the Government and Mercury represents competition, the native got selected in the Income Tax Department of the Government through a very stiff competition.

units.verse_devanagari:
तनुद्विजमुखः शूरो नातिह्रस्वः कृशोदरः ।
मध्ये क्षाम सुजंघश्च मतिमान् पररन्ध्रवित् ।।२०।।
शक्तो वनाद्रिदुर्गेषु सेनानीर्दन्तुरः शशः ।
चंचलो धातुवादी च स्त्रीशक्तोऽन्यधनान्वितः ।।२१।।
मालावीणामृदकिंऽस्त्ररेखांगातकरांघ्रिकः ।
भूपोऽयं वसुधा पाति जीवन् खाद्रिसमाः सुखी ।।२२।।
units.translation: 20-22: Feature of Sasa Yoga : A person having Sasa Purusha Yoga will possess small teeth and soft faces brave but will not have small body. He will have narrow waist with weak loins, elegant thighs, intelligent and will have interests in forests, hills etc., powerful and be an army chief. Such natives do have protruding teeth to some extent, agile, will possess special knowledge in metallurgy, indulges in flirtation with women, plunderer of others wealth etc. This kind of native will have marks like garland (mala), Veena, Mridanga (percussion instrument) and weapons in his hands and feet. After having served the holy Earth and lived happily for 70 years, he departs for the heavenly abode.
units.commentary: Notes : The position of Saturn in the Angular houses and in the sign of Capricorn, Aquarius or Libra will give rise to Sasa Yoga. The Yoga will not be formed in Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius and Pisces Ascendants because the required signs will not fall in the Angular houses with these Ascendants. This Yoga gives excellent results in Libra and Taurus Ascendants because here, Saturn will become Yogakaraka. One should delineate the results in Aries, Cancer, Leo, Scorpio Ascendants with great care, specially in the case of Cancer and Leo Ascendants an extra precaution is to be exercised because the position of Saturn will give the lordship of the 6th or the 8th house as well. In Scorpio Ascendant, due care is also required but with a deep study and proper insight, if the pit falls are located and kept in mind, one can avoid wrong and unmindful prognostications.

units.verse_devanagari:
सन्ख्या रसगुणा कार्या चन्द्रवह्निहृता फलम् ।
संस्थाप्यं प्रथमे कोष्ठे तदर्धं त्रिषु विन्यसेत् ।।२०५ ।।
त्रिभागं वसुकोष्ठेषु विन्यस्य तत्फलं वदेत् ।
एवं द्वादशभावेषु पाचकानि प्रकल्पयेत् ।।२०६ ।।
units.translation: 205-206 : Multiple Sandhya Dasa by 6 and divide it by 31. The resultant value (in terms of year etc.) be kept in first column and ½ part of it be entered in the next three columns. The rest of the eight columns be filled with the figure 1/3rd of the resultant value. In this manner, the Pachaka in Sandhya Dasa be conceptulised.
units.commentary: Notes : The natural Sandhya Dasa is of 10 years duration. If we multiply it by 6 and then divide it by 31, the resultant will be 1 yr.-11 months-6 days. This period be kept in the first column. Half of this value, turns out to be 0 yr. 11 months, 18 days and this figure will go in the next three columes. The next 8 coloumns will carry the figure equivalent to 1/3rd of the resultant value i.e. 0 yr. 7 months 22 days. units.verse_devanagari:
कर्कटे ह्यर्थनाशश्च सिंहे राजविरोधिता ।
मिथुने भूमिलाभश्च वृषभे चार्थलाभकृत् ।। २३ ।।
मेषे सर्पादिभीतिः स्यान्मीने चैव जलाद् भयम् ।
कुम्भे व्यापारतो लाभो मकरेऽपि रुजो भयम् ।। २४ ।।
चापे तु धनलाभः स्याद् वृश्चिकस्य नवांशके ।। २४½ ।।
units.translation: 23-24½: Kalachakra Dasa of Scorpio : In the Navamsa of Cancer, loss of wealth; in the Navamsa of Leo, opposition from the sovereign; in the Navamsa of Gemini, acquisition of land; in the Navamsa of Taurus, gain of wealth; in the Navamsa of Aries, danger from serpants etc; in the Navamsa of Pisces, danger from water; in the Navamsa of Aquarius, gain in the business; in the Navamsa of Capricorn, ill health and in the Navamsa of Sagittarius, acquisition of wealth is indicated. These are the results of the Navamsas of the Scorpio Dasa.
units.commentary: Notes: During the Navamsa of Aquarius of Scorpio Dasa, the native contemplates the plans for the new ventures. If the horoscope has promise of putting up an industry, the foundation of such industry is laid during this period.

units.verse_devanagari:
दायेशाद्भाग्यकोणे वा केन्द्रे वा तुंगराशिगे ।। २३ ।।
स्वदेशे धनलाभश्च पितृमातृसुखावहा ।
गजवाजिसमायुक्तो राजमित्रप्रसादतः ।। २४ ।।
units.translation: 23-24: If Mercury is placed at Angle, Trine from the lord of Mahadasa or in the sign of exaltation, there will be gain of wealth in one's own country, warmth of mother and father; possession of elephants, horses etc. (vehicles) with the blessings of the friendly king.
units.commentary:
Notes: There are different opinions expressed in the Phaladeepika in this context.
i) The first one is that the Antardasa of the Mercury in Jupiter Mahadasa will produce inauspicious results, such as, flirtation with the women, earnings through gamblings and sale of liquors and native will remain sick with gastric, biles, phlegmatic diseases :
ii) The other opinion is that in the Mahadasa of Jupiter will render only auspicious results. During the Antardasa, the native worships deities and Brahmins. He is also blessed with children and wealth. The Antardasa of Mercury in the Mahadasa of Jupiter is considered auspicious in Jataka Parijata. The version of this ancient treatise is that in this Antardasa, the native will profit from the business side; blessings of the king and the time passes through rather quite comfortably. Native undertakes pious deeds and observes austerity. The native with Aries Ascendants, contract diseases like gastric, biles and phlegmatic which is a natural because, in this Ascendant, Mercury takes the lordship of the 6th and the 3rd houses. In this Ascendant, Mercury will produce malefic results regardless of its placement. Apart from this, for Scorpio Ascendant, Mercury will give inauspicious results. Being the lord of the 8th house, the native will naturally take to drinking. In fact, there is no difference of opinion on these two Ascendants.

units.verse_devanagari:
कुजस्यान्तर्गते मन्दे स्वर्क्षे केन्द्रत्रिकोणगे ।
मूलत्रिकोणकेन्द्रे वा तुङ्गांशे स्वांशगे सति ।।२३।।
लग्नाधिपतिना वापि शुभदृष्टियुतेऽसिते ।
राज्यसौख्यं यशोवृद्धिः स्वग्रामे धान्यवृद्धिकृत् ।।२४।।
पुत्रपौत्रसमायुक्तो गृहे गोधनसंग्रहः ।
स्ववारे राजसम्मानं स्वमासे पुत्रवृद्धिकृत् ।।२५।।
units.translation: 23-25: If Saturn is posited in own sign, Angles or Trines, Moolatrikona House, exalted sign or in own Navamsa and in conjunction with or aspected by the lord of the Ascendant or of benefic signs, the Antardasa of Saturn in the Mahadasa of Mars will produce results like, pleasure of the king, boost in fame, accretion of food grain in storage, comforts from son or grandson, accumulation of cattle, felicitation from the king on saturday and child birth in the month of Saturn.
units.commentary: Notes : Antardasa of Saturn does not deliver that good results in the main period of Mars, as embodied in the Shlokas. It is only in the Libra Ascendant, Saturn could offer excellent results because Saturn is the lord of Angular and Trinal house (Yogakaraka). In this Ascendant, Saturn's sub-period is very useful in providing adequate food grains, land, cattle etc. 24th Shloka contains a word "स्वग्रामे" which means 'storage' and combined with another word "अपने गाँव में " in the Shloka would mean "adequate storage of food grain in the village". This result will fructify in the Libra Ascendant only, since Mars and Saturn are the lords of the 2nd and the 4th houses, which are connected with the neighbourhood and village. Similar results could also be expected in the Capricorn Ascendant. Taurus Ascendant may provide identical effects but not at the level one observes with Libra Ascendant.

units.verse_devanagari:
चन्द्रहोरागते कृष्णे सूर्यहोरागते सिते ।
लग्ने नृणां फलज्ञप्त्यै विचिन्त्या षोडशोत्तरी ।। २४ ।।
पुष्यभाज्जन्मभं यावद् या संख्या गजतष्टिता ।
रविर्भौमो गुरुर्मन्दः केतुश्चन्द्रो बुधो भृगुः ।। २५ ।।
इति क्रमाद् दशाधीशाः ज्ञेया राहुं विना ग्रहाः ।
रुद्राद्ये कोत्तराः संख्या धृत्यन्तं वत्सराः क्रमात् ।। २६ ।।
units.translation: 24-26 : If Ascendant (Lagna) is in the Hora of the Moon in Krishna Paksha (waning Moon) or in the Sun's Hora during Shukla Paksha (waxing Moon), Shodsottari Dasa be adopted for prognoslication. Count the number of Nakshatras from Pushyami to the birth Nakshatra and divide it by 8. The remainder will point out the Dasa of the planet barring Rahu, if counted in the order of the Sun, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Ketu, Moon, Mercury and Venus. The Dasa years are from 11 to 18 years with an accretion by one year for each planet in seriatim (i.e., Sun 11, Mars 12, Jupiter 13, Saturn 14, Ketu 15, Moon 16, Mercury 17 and Venus 18 Years).
units.commentary:
Notes : Maharishi recommended to employ Shodshottari Dasa system for Ascendent being in the Hora of the Moon if the birth of the native is in the Krishna Paksha and also in converse situations i.e. birth is in Shukla Paksha and Ascendent is in the Sun Hora. There are only eight planets in this system and Rahu is out of it. The calculation of the expired period of the Shadsottari Dasa are identical to Vimshottari Dasa system. A native has taken birth in Mrigshira Nakshatra and his birth was in the Krishna Paksha and the Ascendent was in Moon’s Hora, the Shodsottari Dasa system will give satisfactory results.
Suppose Bhayaata of Mrigshira is 20 Gh.- 30 Pal. (1230 Pals.) and Bhabhoga being 60 Gh., 10 Pal. (3610 Pals.). As per the Table-6 the Sun Dasa will be ruling at the time of birth (From Pushyami the Mrigshira Nakshatra is ahead of 25 count and if we divide this figure by 8, the remainder comes to 1 i.e. Ist planet which is Sun) Sun has period of 11 years : Expired Period of the Sun : (1230 x 11) / 3610 = 13530 / 3610 = 3.748 yrs.
= 3 years, 8 months, 29 days.

units.verse_devanagari:
भौमाष्टवर्गे संचिन्त्यं भ्रातृविक्रमधैर्यकम् ।
कुजाश्रितात् तृतीयक्षं बुधैभ्रातृगृहं स्मृतम् ।।२४।।
त्रिकोणशोधनं कृत्वा यत्र स्यादधिकं फलम् ।
भूमेर्लाभोऽत्र भार्याया भ्रातृणां सुखमुत्तमम् ।।२५।।
भौमो बलविहीनश्चेद् दीर्घायुर्भ्रातृको भवेत् ।
फलानि यत्र क्षीयन्ते तत्र भौमे गते क्षतिः ।।२६।। तृतीयर्क्षफलेनाथ पिण्डं सम्बर्ध्य पूर्ववत् ।
शेषमृक्षं शनौ याते भ्रातृकष्टं विनिर्दिशेत् ॥२७॥
units.translation:
24-27: From the Ashtakavarga of Mars, the brothers, valour, courage, patience etc. are assessed. The third house from Mars denotes brothers (co-borns)
After Trikona Shodhan, which ever sign has more number, the transit of Mars in that sign will give gains of property and woman (marriage) and affection from the brothers (co-borns). The sign if left with no number after the trikona Shodhana (reduction), the transit of Mars over that sign will produce distress for the brothers (co-borns).
The (total) Shodya Pinda (शोध्य पिण्ड) of Mars be multiplied by the number of Rekhas contained in the 3rd place from Mars and the product be divided by 27 (Nos. of Nakshatras). When the Nakshatra falling at the number denoted by the remainder and Trinal Nakshatras therefrom (10th and 19th) and the sign indicated by the remainder number after dividing the product by 12 and its trinal signs (5th and 9th) are transited by Saturn, it will cause distress to the borthers (co-borns).
units.commentary:
Notes : The status of the Ashtakavarga of Mars in the Model horoscope showing the reductions is as follows : The Rashi Pinda and Graha Pinda be computed as illustrated in the case of Moon's Ashtakavarga and which works out as 100 and, 46 respectively and the Shodhya Pinda 146. Since the 3rd place Brihat Parasara Hora Sastra 563

from the Mars secured only one Rekha the product (146x1) will also be 146. This figure on being divided by 27 will leave the reminder of 11. Therefore, the 11th Nakshatra will be Uttara Phalguni and the 10th and 19th Nakshatras therefrom will be Poorva Ashada and Bharani.
Similarly, if we divide the product by 12, we get remainder as 2. The second sign from Aries will that be of Taurus. The 5th and 9th signs therefrom will be Virgo and Capricorn.
The transit of Saturn over Nakshatras Uttar Phalguni, Poorva Ashada and Bharani and the signs Tauras, Virgo and Capricorn will produce distress for the brothers (co-borns).

units.verse_devanagari:
उच्चस्वर्क्षग्रहे तस्मिञ्छुभं सौख्यं धनागमः ।
तच्छून्यं चेदसौख्यं स्यात्तद्दशा न फलप्रदा ।।२२।।
units.translation: 22: If a sign is posited with exalted or own planet, the Dasa of the sign will afford sensuous enjoyment and wealth. If the sign is devoid of any planet, the Dasa of the sign will be unfavourable and defunct.
units.commentary: Notes: The expression "defunct Dasa" stands to mean that such Dasa will be uneventful.

units.verse_devanagari:
कृष्णपक्षे दिवा जन्म शुक्लपक्षे तथा निशि ।
तदा ह्यष्टोत्तरी चिन्त्या फलार्थञ्च विशेषतः ।।२३।।
units.translation: 23 : O Brahamin! “If the birth is in the day time during Krishna Paksha or in the night in Shukla Paksha and in order to ascertain specific results, Astottari Dasa be adopted”.
units.commentary: Notes : The fundamental difference between Vimsottari and Astottari Dasa systems is that in Vimsottari system, the Nakshatras are allotted in the planetary order. Such as Kritika is ruled by the Sun, Rohini is assigned to the Moon and Mrigshira to Mars and so on, while the Astottari Dasa is altogether on different pattern. Here, malefic planets are allotted four Nakshatras and benefic planets get three Nakshatras. For example : the Sun has Aridra, Punarvasu, Pushya and Ashlesha Nakshatras in his fold, but Jupiter being a benefic planet gets three Nakshatras viz., Dhanishta, Satbisha and Poorva-Bhadarpad. Further, in this Dasa system, the period of the planet is equally distributed amongst the Nakshatra over which it has the dominance. Thus Mars has 8 years of Dasa which has been apportioned between Hasta, Chitra, Swati and Vishakha Nakshatras each getting 2 years. Similar treatment is given to the Nakshatras of the other planets. On the basis of Shlokas 17 to 21, Astottari Dasa table is drawn and shown as Table No.-5.

units.verse_devanagari:
सशुभः पंचमः स्वामी-युक्तो वा तदवेक्षितः ।
सबलो मासपस्तर्हि गर्भं सकुशलं वदेत् ।।३२।।
units.translation: 32 : From the query Ascendant, if the 5th house is occupied by the auspicious planets or conjoined or aspected by the own lord and also the lord of the month (the Sun) is also well fortified, the pregnancy will be safe.
units.commentary: Note : In the reverse situation when the 5th house is occupied or aspected by the malefic planets and is neither conjoined with nor aspected by its lord and also the lord of the month (the Sun) is also weak, the pregnancy gets terminated.

units.verse_devanagari:
बुधभे लग्नगे सूतौ चन्द्रशुक्रयुते द्विज ! ।
ज्ञेया पितृगृहे नारी सा सर्वसुखसंयुता ।। ३६ ।।
units.translation: 36: If the Ascendant contains the sign of Mercury, and it is occupied by the Moon and Venus in the female nativity, she beholds abundant comforts of her father's house.
units.commentary: Notes : The very fact that there are auspicious planets in the Ascendant explains itself that the native had a very comfortable childhood. The Shloka reveals that if the Ascendant be of Mercury's sign which harbours the Moon and Venus in it in a female nativity, such woman enjoys abundant comforts of her parents house (before marriage). The signs of the Mercury represent adolescent stage of the native. The Moon and Venus denote childhood and comforts respectively. Besides, on account of Mercury possessing special qualities, Maharishi has given preference to Mercury in the maxim.

units.verse_devanagari:
लग्नेन्दू समभे यस्याः सा नारी प्रकृतिस्थिता ।
कन्योचितगुणोपेता सुशीला शुभलक्षणा ।। ५ ।।
शुभेक्षितौ सुरूपा च सदा देहसुखान्विता ।
units.translation: 5-5½: If the sign of the Ascendant and the sign in which the Moon is posited, are even signs, that woman will be conjoined with the feminine characteristics and will have the feminish qualities. She will be submissive and possessed with auspicious attributes. Should there be aspects of the benefic planets, she will be exceedingly beautiful and will have sound health and bodily comforts.
units.commentary: Notes : The charateristics of even and odd signs are of different types. Even is also known as Somaya which is synonymous to calmness, serenity, silence, tranquillity, auspiciousness, beautiful, attractive etc. In other words, these qualities are more compatible with the characteristics of the Moon. Probably, with the evolution of the Earth, the word Somaya would have been coined as an expression for the Moon. Therefore, both the even (सम)sign and the Moon are connected with attraction, feelings, tenderness etc. As a matter of fact, the word Somaya is also akin to Mercury who is considered to be the son of the Moon. Therefore, lovely and attractive features should also be studied from Mercury. Venus exclusively is the Karaka for beauty. It is said in the Deva Keralam "शुक्ले शुभे बल रुप राज्योत्सरप्रिय" that is, in a female nativity if Venus is posited in an even sign and the Ascendant is neither occupied or aspected by the malefic signs, that woman will possess calm, composed and quite nature and will also be adomed with delicate womanish qualities. If the sign of the Moon also happenes to be of an even sign and is bereft of malefic aspect and also occupied by the rnalefic planets, such female qualities will get more pronounced. Sage Mantreshwara in his treatise has affirmed this aspect in Shloka which runs as under :

units.verse_devanagari:
मेषे शतं वृषेऽक्षाष्टौ मिथुने त्रिगजाः समाः ।
कर्कटेऽगजाः प्रोक्तास्तावन्तस्तत्तत्-त्रिकोणयोः ।। ८९ ।।
units.translation: 89: In the Kalachakra Dasa, the full life span (Poornayu) for the Aries-Amsa will be of 100 years, Taurus-Amsa 85, Gemini-Amsa 83 and Cancer-Amsa 86 years. The 5th and 9th signs from these signs will also have the same number of years.

units.verse_devanagari:
सर्वज्ञोऽसि महर्षे ! त्वं कृपया दीनवत्सल ! ।
दशाः कतिविधाः सन्ति ! तन्मे कथय तत्त्वतः ।। १ ।।
units.translation: 1: Maitreya said, O Supreme Sage! You are ominiscient and have infinite knowledge. Kindly be merciful and enlighten me, in detail, about the prevalent "Planetary Dasas" (Periods).

units.verse_devanagari:
श्रुताश्च बहुधा भेदा दशानां च मया मुने ! ।
फलं च कीदृशं तासां कृपया मे तदुच्यताम् ? ।। १ ।।
units.translation: 1: Maitreya said; O Venerable Said ! I am enlightened with the various types of Dasas. Kindly apprise me with the nature of their results.

units.verse_devanagari:
अथ विप्र ! प्रवक्ष्यामि योगं प्रव्रज्यकाभिधम् ।
प्रव्रजन्ति जना येन सम्प्रदायान्तरं गृहात् ।। १ ।।
units.translation: 1: Maharishi Parasara said - O Brahmin ! Now I will expound the Yogas which will cause asceticism (Pravrajya) and during which the persons recluse himself from his home and adopt some other religious tenets (discipline).

units.verse_devanagari:
सर्वज्ञोऽसि महर्षे ! त्वं कृपया दीनवत्सल !।
दशाः कतिविधाः सन्ति ! तन्मे कथय तत्त्वतः ।।१।।
units.translation: 1: Maitreya said, O Supreme Sage! You are ominiscient and have infinite knowledge. Kindly be merciful and enlighten me, in detail, about the prevalent “Planetary Dasas” (Periods).

units.verse_devanagari:
ग्रहाणां दोषशान्त्यर्थं तेषां पूजाविधिं वद ! ।
मानवानां हितार्थाय संक्षेपात् कृपया मुने ! ।। १ ।।
units.translation: 1: Maitreya said - O Sage ! Kindly briefly explain the propitiatory measures to alleviate the affliction of the planets for the benefit of the mankind.

units.verse_devanagari:
पुत्रमित्रकलत्रादिसौख्यसम्पन्न एव च ।
नानाविधा च सम्पत्ती रवेः सूक्ष्मगते भृगौ ।।१०।।
units.translation: 10: Sookshmadasa of VENUS in the Pratyantardasa of the SUN : Comforts from children, friends, wife etc. and acquisition of property of different nature.

units.verse_devanagari:
राजपूजा धनाधिक्यं स्त्रीपुत्रादिभवं सुखम् ।
अन्नपानादिभोगादि सूर्यप्राणगते भृगौ ।। १० ।।
units.translation: 10: Pranadasa of VENUS in the Sookshmadasa of the SUN : Felicitation by the king, opulent wealth, pleasure of wife due to birth of a child, enjoyment of eating and drinking etc.

units.verse_devanagari:
द्वाभ्यामेकोऽधिको यश्च तस्याधिक्यं निगद्यते ।
अन्यथा गुणसाम्यं च विज्ञेयं द्विजसत्तम ! ।।१०।।
units.translation: 10: O Great Brahmin ! If one Guna is more fortified then to the other two Gunas, its effects would be the predominant one. Otherwise, all the Gunas should be taken as equal.

units.verse_devanagari:
गुरुर्द्वादशभिर्वर्षैः पुनस्तत्तद्राशिगो भवेत् ।
तत् कस्मिन् पर्यये तस्य ज्ञेयः संवत्सरो नूनम् ! ।। १० ।।
units.translation: 10 : Maitraya enquired - O Maharishi ! Since Jupiter turns around to the same sign after 12 years, which of the cycle (of Jupiter) be considered the year of the birth.

units.verse_devanagari:
प्रव्रज्याकारकः खेटो यद्यन्येन पराजितः ।
तदा लब्ध्वा परिव्रज्यां परित्यजति तां पुनः ।। १० ।।
units.translation: 10: Yoga opposing asceticism : The planet causing asceticism if gets defeated in a planetary war, the native discard the religious precept related to the defeated planet.

units.verse_devanagari:
गुरु-शुक्रौ क्रमात् पीत-श्वेतवर्णौ चतुर्भुजौ ।
दण्डिनौ वरदौ कार्यौ साक्षसूत्र-कमण्डलू ।। १० ।।
units.translation: 10: Jupiter and Venus be perceived respectively, in yellow and white colour and both being four armed, holding staff (दण्ड), Akshasutra (अक्षसूत्र), Kamandal (कमण्डल) and the fourth hand in a state of blessing posture.

units.verse_devanagari:
मर्कटीगमने सव्ये धनधान्य-पशुक्षयः ।
पितुर्मरणमालस्यं तत्समानां च व मृतिः ।। १०३ ।।
units.translation: 103: Dasas with Markati motion occurring in Savya cycle will bring about loss of wealth, prosperity and animals, death of father or elders and laziness.

units.verse_devanagari:
स्त्रीपुत्रादिसुखं द्रव्यं लभते नूतनाम्बरम् ।
योगसिद्धिं समाधिञ्च निजप्राणगते विधौ ।।११।।
units.translation: 11: Pranadasa of the MOON in the Sookshmadasa of the MOON : Pleasure of wife due to birth of a child, gain of wealth and new clothes, subjugation of incantation (yoga-sidhi-योग सिद्धि) to undergo penance etc.

units.verse_devanagari:
त्रिशूलाकृति चिन्ह च ललाटे यदि जायते ।
नारी राजप्रिया ज्ञेया भूपतिश्च नरो भवत् ।। ११ ।।
units.translation: 11: A mark like reddish trident on the forehead if possessed by a woman, she will be bestowed with the affection of a king and if by a man, he begets kingship.
